shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: a buildable sky level above and a solid rock basement below, fully simulated as linked pocket maps with live see-through open air and cross-level pawn AI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, incremental grids, and event-driven work.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only (no Prepatcher, no MultiFloors dependency).
- Cap: 3 levels per column, enforced in LevelMapGen and PlaceWorker_ABStairs.
- Upper-level rules match Z-Levels beta semantics, with documented deviations: floor removal only drops things when the exposed terrain is open air; bomb-punched rooftop holes deferred.
- Basement: 100% solid mineable rock matching surface geology, fogged, thick-roofed; vanilla collapse rules intact.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches (ui, levelGen, rendering, movement, logistics, roofSync, weather); HarmonyBoot per-class patching; fail open everywhere.
- All player-facing text: vanilla sentence case, ASCII only, no long dashes.

## How it works (end of T1.10)
- Core (T0): LevelComp registry on pocket maps aligned 1:1, ground comp as column controller; stairs pairs that generate levels on completion; use-stairs job with safe transfer; PageUp/PageDown camera-preserving level view.
- Sky mountains: mass contracted one cell (walkable ledge ring); two unroofed, unfogged face rows with real rock texture; deep core = thick rock roof + the upper map's own vanilla-style fog. Guaranteed fog reveal on mineable removal; landings mine out and unfog their 3x3.
- See-below renderer (Harmony), final architecture:
  - Surface section submeshes at y=-2.5 under the sky map; knowledge/vision layers (Darkness, FogOfWar, IndoorMask, LightingOverlay) excluded BY TYPE so only world content is copied.
  - Air-cells-only light mask at y=-0.10: base dim + real per-cell light (skylight from current map, artificial glow from the surface's glow grid), night opacity capped at 62% so the ground stays readable. No fog inheritance. Built over a padded view rect (8 cells) and rebuilt only when the camera escapes the pad or the 15-frame light refresh fires; sampling grid world-anchored with resolution hysteresis (no pan jitter, no zoom popping). 32-bit indices.
  - Live dynamic things below via DrawPos offset flag; camera far clip 65.5 -> 70.
- Weather link: sky level adopts ground weather every 150 ticks (vanilla transition, own kill switch).
- Live sync (LevelSync via MapEvents): roof below governs rooftop above live; sky floors write constructed roofs below; things over open air fall with Z-Levels-style consequences.

## Quadruple pass log
T1 series: far clip 92%, contraction 90%, fog band 90%, mining reveal 90%, unroofed faces 92%, air-only mask 88%, Darkness exclusion 93%, weather sync 90%, pan-jitter fix 90%, night readability 88%. Postmortem: the phantom fog had three stacked painters (roofed faces, relocated overlays, SectionLayer_Darkness in the content pass). Polish backlog: far-zoom silhouettes below; water-depth submeshes below; natural-roof removal under sky mountains; bomb holes in rooftops; sky weather decider suppression.

## Tranche plan
- T0 DONE, T1 series CODE DONE (T1.10 awaiting sign-off).
- T2: movement: stair graph, cross-level pathing, drafted moves, pawns auto-use stairs for jobs, non-surface stair placement.
- T3 (next after sign-off, user-requested): cross-map stockpiles/hauling, storage, bills across levels.
- T4: systems: temperature sync, power across levels, threat policy, map-removal cleanup, profiling; renderer polish.

## Status
T1.10 compiled green, pushed. Pending sign-off: smooth panning, readable ground at night, all prior fixes intact.
